characters.summary: Brainiac is a hyper-intelligent Coluan entity who travels across the universe shrinking and bottling cities to preserve their knowledge before destroying their parent planets. In combat, he relies on vast intellect, advanced technological drones, powerful force fields, telepathy, and formidable telekinetic abilities.

Superman-level strength and speed (varies by body)

mechanisms: Force fields that withstand Superman's strongest blows
Downloading his consciousness into spare robotic bodies

weaknesses: Vulnerability to telepathic feedback
Over-reliance on technology and probe ships

Telepathic link to his ship: sudden separation briefly disables him
limitations: Consciousness transfer requires accessible technological infrastructure or spare bodies
Bound by the logical parameters of his programming or obsessive collecting directive
Telepathic/telekinetic powers depend on the body he occupies
Prolonged separation from his ship causes deterioration and power loss

sources.supports: General overview of Brainiac's history, abilities, city-shrinking capabilities, and technological nature across DC Comics continuities.

Employed advanced force fields capable of withstanding Superman's powerful physical blows.
His force field withstood Superman's most powerful blows.
